notes: 51 cases over 8 trials and 14 patients, at version 2. 36 are annotated: labelled criterion by criterion in two independent language-model passes and adjudicated by the maintainer. 15 are constructed: an annotated pair with a recorded list of chart edits applied and the criteria those edits close overridden. No clinician reviewed any of it, and no case outcome was written down by anyone reading a chart as a whole. Every outcome is derived: by the vital-status rule of eval/annotation/protocol.md section 12 where it applies, and otherwise by caliper.logic.roll_up over the criterion labels. Version 2 corrects version 1, which is kept unchanged at eval/answer_key.v1.json with its own digest. Vital status was missing from the annotation protocol, and 20 of these 51 cases are on the five patients the corpus records as having died before the 2026-06-01 screening date. Those cases are ineligible and carry no criterion labels, because no criterion was evaluated; 12 of them changed outcome. eval/annotation/corrections.md lists every change with the chart value behind it, and eval/annotation/refutation.json holds the pre-registered check that tries to contradict every met label against the raw committed FHIR. The key's central finding is unchanged: no patient in this corpus is eligible for any of these eight real protocols as their chart stands, because every protocol bounds at least one quantity no Synthea chart carries -- a liver panel for NCT01131676, a UACR for NCT02545049, NCT03819153 and NCT06717698, a cystatin C-based eGFR for NCT06717698, ECOG and RECIST and a brain MRI for NCT05748834, mMRC and pack-years and spirometry percent-predicted for NCT07252908, and an NYHA class for NCT03036124. Under the annotation protocol a test not done is unknown rather than normal, and unknown propagates. All six eligible cases are therefore constructed, all six are on NCT03315143, and every one rests on a type 2 diabetes diagnosis and a renal value that a recorded chart edit supplied to a patient whose real chart carries prediabetes. The build names all 18 such labels every time it runs, and protocol.md section 12 says why they were kept rather than dropped.
